question: What was the main agenda of United Nations Katowice Conference held in December 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Climate change**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main agenda of the United Nations Katowice Conference held in December 2018 was **Climate change**.
 
• The conference, known as COP24, was the 24th session of the Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).
 
• It aimed to finalize the rules for the implementation of the Paris Agreement, which seeks to limit global warming to well below 2 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels.
 
• Delegates from around the world gathered to discuss and negotiate measures to combat climate change and to ensure transparency and accountability in the implementation of climate actions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Paris Agreement was adopted in December 2015 and has been signed by 196 countries.
 
• The agreement emphasizes the need for global cooperation in reducing greenhouse gas emissions and adapting to the impacts of climate change.
 
• Key components of the agreement include nationally determined contributions (NDCs), financial support for developing countries, and mechanisms for transparency and accountability.
 
• The Katowice Climate Package, adopted at COP24, provides detailed guidelines for the implementation of the Paris Agreement.
